exposure: preeclampsia (mild vs. severe features vs. healthy controls)
presence of maternal adverse outcomes (neurological symptoms)
outcome: fibrosis index based on four factors (FIB-4) score
cohort: The study included 142 patients with mild preeclampsia, 190 patients with preeclampsia with severe features, and 79 healthy pregnant controls.
finding: Healthy controls had significantly lower FIB-4 scores than women with mild preeclampsia, and women with mild preeclampsia had significantly lower FIB-4 scores than women with severe preeclampsia, with a FIB-4 score >=0.758 indicating the presence of neurologic symptoms in preeclampsia patients.
